newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE, Canada commodity markets closed on Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: WCE, Canada commodity markets closed on Jan 1.

text.p: The Winnipeg Commodity Exchange and most Canadian cash grain and livestock markets were scheduled to close early Tuesday and remain closed Jan 1.
Trade on the WCE will end at 1220 CST/1720 GMT on New Year's Eve.
The Canadian Wheat Board, Manitoba Pool Elevators, Ontario Agriculture Ministry and other agencies said no cash prices would be issued on New Year's Day but will reopen Thursday.
